g.text: Title: Battery gauge and Guition interface

g.desc: Title: Battery gauge and Guition interface

g.text: Engineering review draft | Charge-arm shunt initially OPEN

g.desc: Engineering review draft | Charge-arm shunt initially OPEN

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: PACK_P = protected red P+ / GND = protected black P-.

g.desc: PACK_P = protected red P+ / GND = protected black P-.

g.text: Two 3400 mAh parallel cells: 6800 mAh nominal, one voltage stack.

g.desc: Two 3400 mAh parallel cells: 6800 mAh nominal, one voltage stack.

g.text: The fuel gauge reads the protected pack. All communication pull-ups use the Guition board's 3.3 V supply.

g.desc: The fuel gauge reads the protected pack. All communication pull-ups use the Guition board's 3.3 V supply.

g.text: Disconnect Guition USB power for the button to switch the device fully off.

g.desc: Disconnect Guition USB power for the button to switch the device fully off.

g.text: Do not connect the protected pack to Guition CN4 / its onboard charger.

g.desc: Do not connect the protected pack to Guition CN4 / its onboard charger.

g.text: Connector pitch, mechanical mate and cable ampacity remain to be verified.

g.desc: Connector pitch, mechanical mate and cable ampacity remain to be verified.

g.text: JP1 pins 23/25 belong to the existing GPIO7/8 touch bus and are unused here.

g.desc: JP1 pins 23/25 belong to the existing GPIO7/8 touch bus and are unused here.

g.text: GPIO35 (BOOT), GPIO52 and ESP32-C6 pins are deliberately unconnected.

g.desc: GPIO35 (BOOT), GPIO52 and ESP32-C6 pins are deliberately unconnected.

g.text: The firmware must add the new GPIO28/29 I2C bus; it is not implemented.

g.desc: The firmware must add the new GPIO28/29 I2C bus; it is not implemented.

g.text: These symbols declare real power sources to KiCad.

g.desc: These symbols declare real power sources to KiCad.

g.text: They are drawing aids and add no physical parts.

g.desc: They are drawing aids and add no physical parts.

g.text: GPIO28 / pin21 = I2C SDA GPIO29 / pin14 = I2C SCL

g.desc: GPIO28 / pin21 = I2C SDA GPIO29 / pin14 = I2C SCL

g.text: GPIO30 / pin12 = CO TX GPIO31 / pin10 = CO RX (host perspective)

g.desc: GPIO30 / pin12 = CO TX GPIO31 / pin10 = CO RX (host perspective)

g.text: GPIO32 / pin19 = power INT GPIO33 / pin8 = power KILL

g.desc: GPIO32 / pin19 = power INT GPIO33 / pin8 = power KILL

g.text: GPIO34 / pin17 = He enable GPIO49 / pin13 = charger INT

g.desc: GPIO34 / pin17 = He enable GPIO49 / pin13 = charger INT

g.text: GPIO50 / pin11 = gauge ALT GPIO51 / pin9 = CO UART enable

g.desc: GPIO50 / pin11 = gauge ALT GPIO51 / pin9 = CO UART enable

g.text: Pin numbers match the vendor JP1 drawing. Confirm the physical mating view.

g.desc: Pin numbers match the vendor JP1 drawing. Confirm the physical mating view.

g.text: 5 V flows TO Guition; HOST_3V3 returns FROM its switched 3.3 V regulator.

g.desc: 5 V flows TO Guition; HOST_3V3 returns FROM its switched 3.3 V regulator.

g.text: The IC reports pack voltage and estimated charge.

g.desc: The IC reports pack voltage and estimated charge.

g.text: R301 pulls the alert signal high.

g.desc: R301 pulls the alert signal high.

g.text: R302/R303: FIT 4.7k on this new bus.

g.desc: R302/R303: FIT 4.7k on this new bus.

g.text: Verify rise time with the complete harness.

g.desc: Verify rise time with the complete harness.
